lines.en: - Well, they're not even touching the lasagna.
- It's hard to believe, just a little while ago,
- Everyone seems to like your dish.
- I thought it was quite tasty.
- So if everyone liked it, and you liked it,
that would make this a success,
which would make you a bitch.
- Well, I was going for wrong, but we can use your word.
And I have to say, you really impressed me today.
You might even say that she pulled a Monica.
She doesn't know we switched it.
